data.title: XAEL-AI Facilitates Cross-Border Robotics Industry Visit for Three U.S. Participants in China
data.description: Shenzhen, China--(Newsfile Corp. - November 2, 2026) - XAEL-AI organized a factory visit in China for three participants from the United States, providing firsthand exposure to robotics equipment and an opportunity to examine the practical considerations involved in commercial service robot applications.
